{{- /* The API reference page a symbol name in a guide resolves to, for the guide's code spans: `IMeasure` in the HTML page (guide-body.html) and in its Markdown version (md/code-links.html), so both link the same names to the same pages. The name is looked up in the page version's api_refs (api-data.html): first in the packages the page documents (its `api_symbols`), which win when a name exists in several packages, then in every package through api-name-index.html, which drops ambiguous names rather than guess. Expects: dict "page" (the guide) "name" (the symbol name, any case). Returns the reference page's RelPermalink, or "" when the name does not resolve (no data file, an internal or React type). */ -}} {{- $page := .page -}} {{- $key := lower .name -}} {{- $url := "" -}} {{- with (partialCached "api-data.html" $page $page.Section).refs -}} {{- $refs := . -}} {{- $path := "" -}} {{- range $page.Params.api_symbols -}} {{- $parts := split (strings.TrimPrefix "@gooddata/" .) ":" -}} {{- if and (eq (len $parts) 2) (not $path) -}} {{- with index $refs (printf "%s.%s" (index $parts 0) $key) }}{{ $path = .path }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not $path -}} {{- $path = index (partialCached "api-name-index.html" $refs $page.Section) $key | default "" -}} {{- end -}} {{- with $path }}{{ with site.GetPage . }}{{ $url = .RelPermalink }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $url -}}
